subject: Request: temporary H200 reservation + transient overage cap for Coflow Labs
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Fiona Patel <fiona@coflow.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary H200 reservation + transient overage cap for Coflow Labs

Hi Lauren / Laura,

Quick summary — Coflow (pilot customer) needs a short-term guaranteed H200 reservation for a 6-week pilot starting 2028-06-10. They forecast 10k gen hours / week at peak; their engineering team is tied to H200-family performance for latency-sensitive models.

Ask: can we provision a temporary reservation hold (6 weeks), allow transient burst up to +40% of committed capacity, and cap overage unit rate at $2.75/hr (below standard overage) for the pilot window? Coflow is asking for a one-time commercial concession (25% credit on month-1 usage) in exchange for a 12-month post-pilot renewal commitment if pilot hits SLAs.

I attached their capacity worksheet and our commercial summary. This is time-sensitive — sales ops needs a yes/no today to lock the pilot offer before Monday.

Details:
- Pilot start: 2028-06-10
- Requested reservation: 20 H200 units (6 weeks)
- Burst: up to 40% transient (peak)
- Overage cap requested: $2.75/hr
- One-time credit: 25% of month-1 usage (contingent on renewal)

Why we should consider: Coflow is an AI-native startup with YC backing, strong PR potential, and fast path to paid adoption. If we deny, they will evaluate another infra vendor this week.

Next step: Lauren, can you fast-track to deal desk / exec review? If you want, I can draft a short exec memo.

Thanks,
Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 May 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary H200 reservation + transient overage cap for Coflow Labs

Jonas — thanks for the clear ask. A few quick clarifying points before I escalate:
1) Confirm whether Coflow will accept a hybrid (mix of H200 + H100) if full H200 inventory is constrained.
2) Need the expected net ARR if they convert after pilot (even a conservative $ figure helps).
3) Legal wants the renewal language template (12-month commitment + minimum monthly utilization) — I can scope that but need your go-ahead.

I can open an expedited deal-desk thread with exec recommendation. If we are approving an overage cap below policy we will need exec signoff and an expiration date on the concession. Grace, can you weigh in on whether treasury / discount burn is OK for this profile?

Lauren
--
Lauren Bishop
Principal Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Fiona Patel <fiona@coflow.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 May 2028 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary H200 reservation + transient overage cap for Coflow Labs

Lauren — answers inline:
1) Coflow prefers full H200 but is open to a 70/30 H200/H100 mix if we can guarantee performance with that hybrid.
2) Conservative net ARR if converted: $980k ARR (based on pilot -> production forecast they shared).
3) Yes please, Laura — go ahead and prep the renewal language.

I've pasted a short one-line business justification for the exec memo: Coflow is a strategic pilot with rapid expansion signal — approving a short-term reservation and capped overage will materially increase conversion probability and surface us as the reliable infra partner they need.

Fiona — thanks for the quick turnaround on the workbook. Jonas will push the details to legal if we proceed.

Jonas
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 May 2028 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: temporary H200 reservation + transient overage cap for Coflow Labs

Thanks team — reviewed commercial summary and capacity worksheet. I'm OK to approve a time-limited reservation hold and a reduced overage cap with conditions:

Decision (high level):
- Approve: temporary reservation hold for up to 6 weeks for up to 20 H200-equivalent units, with allowance for a 40% transient burst.
- Approve (partial): overage cap set at $2.95/hr for the pilot window (I cannot go to $2.75/hr below margin threshold).
- Approve (commercial concession): one-time credit up to 15% of month-1 usage, contingent on signed 12-month renewal within 30 days of pilot completion and minimum monthly utilization clause.

Conditions & next steps:
1) Legal to finalize the renewal template and include a clawback for the credit if Coflow fails to sign the renewal. Laura — please coordinate.
2) Reservation hold to be set in the system and expire automatically at the end of the 6-week window unless extended by an exec-level re-approval.
3) If H200 inventory is constrained, allow hybrid mix (min 60% H200 equivalent) but keep overage cap unchanged.
4) Finance will record this as a negotiated concession against Q3 forecast.

Lauren — please draft the brief exec approval note and update the HubSpot deal with the approved terms. Jonas — communicate the approved terms to Coflow and attach the DocuSign link for the pilot addendum.

Grace
--
Grace O'Connor
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Subject: Coflow pilot — approved reservation & concession summary

Fiona / Daniel / Coflow procurement —

Thank you for the productive calls. Per internal approval, Redwood can proceed with the following pilot terms:

Approved items:
- Reservation: temporary hold for 20 H200-equivalent units, 6-week window starting 2028-06-10.
- Burst: allowed transient burst up to 40% of committed units.
- Overage cap: $2.95/hr (pilot window only).
- One-time credit: 15% of month-1 usage applied as a bill credit, contingent on signed 12-month renewal within 30 days of pilot completion.

Next steps:
1) I've opened a short DocuSign addendum for the pilot and attached it here: https://docusign.com/rw/coflow/pilot-addendum (stub).
2) Legal (Laura) will send the final renewal template and clawback clause.
3) Engineering ops will place the temporary reservation in the provisioning system by Monday morning.

Fiona — please confirm acceptance of these terms so we can route the DocuSign and lock capacity. If anything in the summary is different from what we discussed, flag immediately.

Appreciate the team moving quickly on this.

Best,
Jonas
